answer.summary: Requests parallelized Elasticsearch index creation across dataset shards and retaining the resulting index mapping for whole-dataset search.
Issue reports a FileNotFoundError when loading a local image dataset after updating the datasets version.
DaNE contains empty samples at the end of the train and test splits, which may cause errors; a fix was reported and planned for the next release.
No official bug, enhancement, or question label is present; the issue concerns an InvalidVersion error when loading the GLUE CoLA dataset with older dependencies.
Issue reports a NonMatchingChecksumError while loading the GLUE/QQP dataset.
Requests adding with_transform and/or set_transform support to IterableDataset to reduce waiting time and resource use for large datasets.
No official labels are present. The issue reports ArrowNotImplementedError when loading CSV data with list-valued features.
Request to add the SQuAD2.0 dataset; comments note it was already available on the Hub and the issue was closed.
Reports incorrect website usage examples for the amazon_us_reviews dataset and bullet-list formatting issues.
Dataset extraction fails when ZIP files are on read-only paths because lock files are created beside the archives.
The issue asks how to reuse generic dataset loading functionality and formats when creating specific datasets, using Brat as an example.
The issue proposes adding a semantic segmentation guide to the documentation. Official labels include documentation, not bug, enhancement, or question.
Issue reports an unclear ValueError when interleaving datasets of differing types or splits.
Issue titled “Bug get_metadata_patterns arg error”; no official labels are present.
No official bug, enhancement, or question label is present. The issue reports inability to reach swda.py in datasets 1.2.0 and was resolved by installing the latest version.
Loading the timit_asr dataset fails with duplicate-key errors and previously required uppercase file extensions.
Issue reports a ModuleNotFoundError for fsspec.exceptions when importing datasets 1.13.3.
Unsupported data files raise an uninformative TypeError ('NoneType' object is not iterable); the issue requests a clearer error message.
Issue reports TensorFlow documentation code errors involving DataCollatorWithPadding and the return_tensors argument.
Closed issue titled “0x290B112ED1280537B24Ee6C268a004994a16e6CE” containing a dataset-addition template; official label is “dataset request.”
Issue reports a TypeError involving unexpected keyword argument 'hf' when loading CSV data from S3; similar reports mention Parquet. The issue is closed and has no official labels.
No official labels are present. The issue reports unexpected cache behavior in datasets 3.x; a comment explains separate datasets and Hugging Face Hub caches.
Adding GPT-2 special tokens causes an ArrowInvalid error because special_tokens_mask values exceed the int8 range used by datasets optimization.
Feature request to automatically display total and per-split downloaded dataset sizes on dataset pages.
Issue reports DuplicatedKeysError when generating the msr_sqa dataset due to duplicate key nt-639.
Reports that overwriting a dataset split changes its data but not metadata, causing errors and potentially corrupting the dataset.
No official labels are present. The reporter ultimately identified the failure as related to a .zst dataset rather than a datasets library fault.
Issue reports Dataset.map stalling near 99% while normalizing a very large dataset, with heavy I/O during processing.
Issue proposes renaming ANLI to avoid confusion with the ART dataset.
Intermittent KeyError when re-running cached dataset mapping for a masked language modeling dataset; fixed in version 1.15.
Requests renaming the generic `datasets` package to avoid conflicts with user modules; maintainers note this would break existing code.
Reports ArrowIndexError from Dataset.select when indices span multiple chunks with pyarrow <1.0.0.
Dataset.map() executes twice in PyTorch DDP mode; labels are absent. Comments identify differing function fingerprints across processes as the likely cause.
Reports ~1000x slower iteration after shuffling an IterableDataset loaded from multiple Arrow files; comments indicate reproduction requires NumPy format.
Reports that compression kwargs and inferred compression have no effect when saving datasets to CSV, resulting in uncompressed files.
Requests an API to obtain dynamic module paths to support Ray-based hyperparameter tuning across spawned processes.
Issue reports load_dataset failing when multiple JSONL files contain fully empty columns, due to premature schema inference.
Requests automatic sharding of large datasets when saving with to_parquet instead of producing one monolithic Parquet file.
Intermittent “Invalid token passed!” errors occur while setting up tests for private datasets.
No official labels are assigned. The issue reports a dataset-loading error when JSON and JSONL files are inferred together.
Issue reports that the cc100 dataset could not be imported; a comment says it was newly added and recommends upgrading datasets.
Importing datasets fails with an AttributeError from fsspec due to an outdated version or environment mismatch.
The issue reports that tensor dtype information is lost when converting through lists and Arrow, causing float32 data to become float64.
Issue proposes parallelizing add_faiss_index across dataset shards to improve performance, while noting potential retrieval-accuracy and merging constraints.
Loading the CoQA dataset fails with a NonMatchingChecksumError in some environments.
Issue reports CUDA out-of-memory errors during training; switching to LineByLineTextDataset avoids the problem.
add_column() fails on datasets sliced with select(), reporting the original table length instead of the sliced length.
The issue asks whether concatenate_datasets can support concatenating columns (axis=1) in addition to rows.
Issue reports an ImageFolder metadata.jsonl loading error with images.zip when using datasets 3.2.0.
The MBPP dataset is missing the paper’s intended few-shot, test, validation, and fine-tuning splits.
Issue reports a RuntimeError about ambiguous sharding when loading some datasets, introduced after multiprocessing changes.
Issue requests restoring or retaining a dataset examples explorer for viewing dataset examples.
Requests loading Hub-hosted tabular and text files via load_dataset without dataset scripts, with data_files split mapping, private repository support, and streaming.
Requests support for loading multiple CSV files from a ZIP archive, with discussion of URL-chaining API options.
Issue reports a TypeError when casting features while processing the conll2012_ontonotesv5 dataset in datasets v2.2.2.
Dataset viewer for liweili/c4_200m returned a 404 error; comments identify a streaming-mode path issue and report the dataset code was later fixed.
Issue asks how to disable or defer Arrow table construction when loading datasets; no official labels are present.
Quick Tour dataset viewer links returned a 502 Bad Gateway error.
Issue provides a template for proposing a new dataset; it is closed and has no official labels or comments.
Requests an API to retrieve dataset metadata, including language and a human-readable name, from load_dataset inputs.

Issue asks why tokenizing a dataset with map produces a tokenized Arrow file over twice the original size.

Request to document DatasetInfo attributes in the project documentation.
Issue reports an AttributeError while loading local JSON files; a comment recommends using the built-in JSON loader.
The dataset’s to_json method does not apply the requested compression parameter, unlike pandas, resulting in an uncompressed output file.
Large-dataset deduplication triggers a PyArrow array size limitation error.

Issue asks whether a 5 GB text file expanding beyond 1 TB during preprocessing is normal or a bug; discussion attributes it to padded int64 tokenization outputs.

SQuAD v2 dataset entries have answer_start offsets misaligned with answer text due to removed leading spaces.
Request to add the MRQA dataset; labeled "dataset request". The issue is closed, with a comment indicating completion.

Issue reports that passing config_kwargs prevents selecting DEFAULT_CONFIG_NAME when multiple dataset configs exist.

Issue reports a ValueError involving an invalid '**' glob pattern when loading datasets, likely related to fsspec versions.

Request to add the LIDC-IDRI lung CT image dataset.

Issue asks how to compute BLEU-4 using load_metric and how it differs from sacrebleu; no official labels are present.
Feature request to add IIIF support to the datasets library, including standardized image retrieval and related APIs.
